FNUS86 KHNX 232306
FWLHNX

ECCDA DISCUSSIONS
NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE SAN JOAQUIN VALLEY - HANFORD CA
406 PM PDT FRI OCT 23 2026

ECC019-241715-
MARIPOSA-
DISCUSSION FOR MARIPOSA ECC DISPATCH
406 PM PDT FRI OCT 23 2026


TEMPERATURES REMAIN ABOUT 5-10 DEGREES BELOW AVERAGE THROUGHOUT THE
REGION TODAY AND ARE EXPECTED TO WARM TO NEAR AVERAGE THIS WEEKEND.
MOSTLY LIGHT TO MODERATE RAIN SHOWERS WITH A FEW LOCALIZED POCKETS
OF MODERATE TO HEAVY RAIN ARE CURRENTLY BEING OBSERVED MAINLY IN THE
SOUTHERN SAN JOAQUIN VALLEY, FOOTHILLS, AND MOJAVE DESERT. IN
ADDITION, GIVEN THESE RAIN SHOWERS ARE CURRENTLY BEING OBSERVED
THERE IS A SMALL CHANCE OF LOCALIZED ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS (5-10%).
RAIN IS EXPECTED TO TAPER OFF BY LATE THIS EVENING INTO THE
OVERNIGHT HOURS WITH DRY CONDITIONS THROUGHOUT THE AREA EXPECTED
THIS WEEKEND. GIVEN THE RECENT RAINFALL THROUGHOUT THE AREA DAYTIME
HUMIDITY VALUES HAVE IMPROVED CONSIDERABLY. WINDS REMAIN GENERALLY
DIURNAL AND TERRAIN DRIVEN.


$$

ECC021-241715-
FRESNO-
DISCUSSION FOR FRESNO ECC DISPATCH
406 PM PDT FRI OCT 23 2026


TEMPERATURES REMAIN ABOUT 5-10 DEGREES BELOW AVERAGE THROUGHOUT THE
REGION TODAY AND ARE EXPECTED TO WARM TO NEAR AVERAGE THIS WEEKEND.
MOSTLY LIGHT TO MODERATE RAIN SHOWERS WITH A FEW LOCALIZED POCKETS
OF MODERATE TO HEAVY RAIN ARE CURRENTLY BEING OBSERVED MAINLY IN THE
SOUTHERN SAN JOAQUIN VALLEY, FOOTHILLS, AND MOJAVE DESERT. IN
ADDITION, GIVEN THESE RAIN SHOWERS ARE CURRENTLY BEING OBSERVED
THERE IS A SMALL CHANCE OF LOCALIZED ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS (5-10%).
RAIN IS EXPECTED TO TAPER OFF BY LATE THIS EVENING INTO THE
OVERNIGHT HOURS WITH DRY CONDITIONS THROUGHOUT THE AREA EXPECTED
THIS WEEKEND. GIVEN THE RECENT RAINFALL THROUGHOUT THE AREA DAYTIME
HUMIDITY VALUES HAVE IMPROVED CONSIDERABLY. WINDS REMAIN GENERALLY
DIURNAL AND TERRAIN DRIVEN. SOME LOCALIZED STRONGER WIND GUSTS
EXCEEDING 35 MPH ARE LIKELY ALONG THE SIERRA CREST FROM THIS EVENING
THROUGH LATE TOMORROW MORNING (55-75% CHANCE).
